<thought>The observed isotopic envelope consists of a series of peaks spaced by ~1 Da with intensities decreasing roughly geometrically (100 → 19.7 → 2.25 → 0.188 → ...). This pattern matches the natural 13C isotopic distribution for a molecule containing many carbons, and no characteristic M+2 (≈33 % of M) or equal‑intensity M+2 pattern that would indicate chlorine or bromine. Thus the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
